name: dsplit
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::dsplit.int(Tensor(a -> *) self, int sections) -> Tensor(a)[]. The correctness suite also covers aten::dsplit.array(Tensor(a -> *) self, int[] indices) -> Tensor(a)[]. dsplit requires rank three or greater and partitions dimension 2, returning a tuple of views whose length, per-part value, shape, dtype, stride, storage offset, view state, shared input storage, and write-through behavior are checked through both the public flag_gems API and the torch dispatcher. Coverage includes evenly divisible integer section counts, explicit ascending, repeated, descending, and out-of-range indices, empty and overlapping slices, four-dimensional and noncontiguous inputs, floating and integer dtypes including int8 boundary values, and distinct nonuniform per-output backward gradients. Integer sections must evenly divide dimension 2; nonpositive counts, non-divisible dimensions, and inputs below rank three are rejected. The operation does not mutate self, while every tensor element of the logical parts list aliases self; Protocol v6.0 effects cannot represent aliases for individual elements of a tensor-list output.
